title: Sensor Tower: EA led all publishers in 2025 with 200M+ PC and console downloads, ahead of its $55B deal to go private; Fortnite had the top console player base (Payton Turkeltaub/Variety)
summary: Payton Turkeltaub / Variety: Sensor Tower: EA led all publishers in 2025 with 200M+ PC and console downloads, ahead of its $55B deal to go private; Fortnite had the top console player base — Soon-to-be privately-owned game publisher and developer Electronic Arts saw the most PC/console game downloads of the year …
